purpose: Teach: 射程/救世主/宮廷/攻防/急落/惹き/激動/無念

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、新薬、本気で、医療の射程、絶対、広げていきます、絶対、患者さんの未来、本気で、守ってまいります、本当に、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: Ren, I'm committed to broadening medicine's reach with this new drug. I'll protect my patients' futures with everything I have. I promise you that.
lines.style: Steady opening, weight behind each clause. No rush. The tone of someone who has made a promise to herself first. Measured, honest, no performance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 先生は、患者さんにとって、本気で、救世主のような、存在ですね、本当に、頭が下がる、思いです、絶対、本気で、感謝、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: You're like a saviour to your patients, Doctor. I mean that. The gratitude I feel — it's profound. Truly.
lines.style: Hesitant at first, finding the right words. Soft earnestness. Not flowery — the fumbling of someone trying to express something genuine. Eyes slightly lowered.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。古代宮廷の医療文化、本気で、研究して、面白いですよね、絶対、本気で、現代に、活かせる、知恵、ありますよね、本気、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. Ancient medical practices from the imperial courts — there's real wisdom there we could apply today. It's fascinating.
lines.style: Thoughtful, opening into genuine interest. Not lecturing — sharing an observation. Slight lift at 'fascinating,' like the idea renews her a little.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療と病気との、本気で、攻防、絶対、深刻ですね、先生、本気で、現場の方々、感謝、しております、絶対、本気で、本当に、頭が下がる。
lines.en: The struggle between medicine and disease is so serious, Doctor. The people in the field — I'm grateful for them. Truly humbled.
lines.style: Quiet, reflective. Not heavy-handed, but the words carry weight. Pause slightly before 'the people in the field,' like he's thinking of real faces. Small, sincere.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。患者さんの容体、本気で、急落することも、絶対、ございます、医療現場、本当に、緊張感、保ってまいります、本気で、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. A patient's condition can deteriorate suddenly. That's the reality we work with. I keep that tension with me every day. It matters.
lines.style: Direct, not cold. The steadiness of someone who has held that weight many times. Quiet acknowledgment of difficulty without dramatising. Clear-eyed.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療研究、本気で、患者さんの希望、惹きつける、力、ありますよね、先生、本気で、絶対、応援、しております、本当に、感謝、絶対。
lines.en: Medical research has the power to give patients hope, doesn't it? Doctor, I support you. I'm truly grateful for what you do.
lines.style: Soft beginning, building slight conviction. Not effusive. The sincerity of someone who has thought about this. Steady eye contact implied by the directness.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。医療界、本気で、激動の時代、先生方、本気で、頑張っております、絶対、感謝、いただきたいです、本当に、本気で、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. Medicine is changing rapidly now. My colleagues are working hard. I hope you know I'm grateful for their effort too.
lines.style: Composed, with a hint of the weight she carries. Not asking for praise — acknowledging the collective effort. Quiet respect for peers without self-deprecation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 病に、本気で、無念に、亡くなった方々、本当に、心が、痛みますね、先生、本気で、医療、頑張ってまいりたいです、絶対、本気で、感謝、絶対。
lines.en: Those who've died from illness — I think of them. The sadness stays with me. That's why I want to keep working in medicine, Doctor. Thank you for what you do.
lines.style: Quieter than before, almost confessional. The words come from somewhere real. No performance. Slight tremor of genuine emotion under the surface, held steady.
